draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.20, the 89th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 8th of 23 at DT. He lasted until pick 123, well after his grade rank (89th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Abry Jones. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1 sacks in 2022, 17th of 23 DTs in his class with stats.
